How it stays useful

  • GitHub is the source.Requirements and references are loaded from the repository.
  • Results are separate.A linked test is not presented as a passing test.
  • Reviews are portable.Business verdicts can be exported and imported as JSON.
  • New requirements appear naturally.Add them to the specification and refresh this page.
